headlines.title: NASA Will Attempt to Observe Rocket Part’s Lunar Impact
headlines.summary: Using ground-based telescopes and space-based assets, NASA and SpaceX are tracking a used Falcon 9 upper stage from a commercial mission expected to impact the Moon on Wednesday, Aug. 5, near the Einstein and Bell crater
